name: Sevens Dominoes
description: Sevens is a domino layout game where players build a triangular pattern from doubles and sequential non-doubles, trying to be first to play all tiles.

overview.description: Sevens is a domino layout game where players build a triangular pattern from doubles and sequential non-doubles, trying to be first to play all tiles.

history.origins: Sevens Dominoes is described as the domino equivalent of Fan Tan (Sevens), documented in modern form through published internet rules.
timeline: 2001: Documented by Joe Celko in online domino references.
2020: Rules page updated with triangular build pattern and lead rules.

setup.players: Best for 2-3 players; 4 players leave no boneyard.
setup.dealing: Each player draws 7 tiles; remaining tiles form a boneyard.
setup.equipment: Double-six dominoes and table space for a triangle layout.

rules.objective: Be the first player to domino by playing all tiles.
rules.gameplay: Highest double leads; if no one has a double, redeal. Players then place tiles into the Sevens triangle pattern: doubles progress by adjacent rank on the top row, while non-doubles are placed beneath according to the one-step pip progression pattern. If a player can play, they must play. If not, they draw one tile from boneyard; when boneyard is empty and no play is possible, they pass.
keyRules: If no double is held by any player, redeal.
Draw from boneyard when blocked; pass only when boneyard is empty.

strategy.basic: Prioritize moves that keep future placement options open in multiple triangle lanes.
strategy.intermediate: Track missing doubles and near-needed connector tiles to anticipate forced draws.
strategy.advanced: Steer play toward branches where opponents are likely to stall and draw repeatedly.
tips: Early control of top-row doubles strongly shapes the lower triangle development.
Preserve flexible tiles that can satisfy multiple potential placements.

variations.name: Free Start
variations.description: Some groups allow any opening tile or a random boneyard starter instead of highest double.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Free Start only changes opening tile rule; no engine constant overrides documented.

scoring.description: No running points are required in the core rules; the hand winner is the first player to domino.
scoring.winCondition: Be first to play all tiles.

synthesis.shortDescription: Sevens Dominoes is a tactical layout game where doubles form the top row and non-doubles expand a strict triangular progression.
